land-rover/series.title: Endless Rain, the Philosophy of Constant Forward Motion, and the National Cuisine of Costa Rica
land-rover/series.author: Sinuhe Xavier
land-rover/series.note: Part 2 of photographer Sinuhe Xavier’s scene report from a Panama-to-Mexico drive in a friend’s 1968 Land Rover Series IIA — mechanical failures, torrential rain and a lot of rice and beans.

grenadier/station-wagon.title: 5 Year Trip in an INEOS Grenadier Across the World towing a Patriot X3 Which We Live In
grenadier/station-wagon.author: Matt P
grenadier/station-wagon.note: A family with two young kids left the Grenadier pub in London in July 2023 in a Trialmaster-spec Grenadier, towing a Patriot X3 camper they live in — through Romania and the Stans and heading east. Why they trusted a new truck for five years: mostly proven components and a five-year global warranty.

land-cruiser/100-series.title: OVR Project LC100: first trail run in our budget Toyota Land Cruiser
land-cruiser/100-series.note: A five-owner 1999 LC100 with nearly 300,000 miles takes on Bailey Canyon in the San Bernardino National Forest on OME rear springs, Tundra wheels, Slee slider steps, a BIO dual swing-out bumper and a hidden Smittybilt winch — plus an honest list of what the mechanic found after purchase.

g-class/w460.title: Mercedes-Benz G-Class travels the world
g-class/w460.note: Gunther Holtorf’s 300 GD ‘Otto’, bought in 1988, covered roughly 559,000 miles and 215 countries between 1990 and 2014 before retiring to the Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart. The original overlanding G.

land-cruiser/fj40.title: Toyota Land Cruiser classic drive review
land-cruiser/fj40.note: MotorTrend gets behind the wheel of classic Land Cruisers, the trucks that built the nameplate’s reputation for going anywhere and coming back.
